nuggets.text: Pat Fitzgerald's 30-20 win over Toledo in his Spartans debut was his first as a head coach since August 27, 2022.
Pat Fitzgerald was the first two-time winner of both the Nagurski Trophy and the Bednarik Award, as a Northwestern linebacker.
Pat Fitzgerald was just 31 when Northwestern made him head coach, the youngest in the FBS at the time.
The Spartans lead the FBS in time of possession after holding the ball for 43:16 against Toledo.
The Spartans are a perfect 7-0 all-time against Eastern Michigan heading into Saturday's meeting.
The Spartans' 1966 showdown with Notre Dame, known as the Game of the Century, ended in a 10-10 tie.
The Spartans and Notre Dame, their next opponent, battle for the Megaphone Trophy.
The Spartans claim six national championships: 1951, 1952, 1955, 1957, 1965 and 1966.
Alessio Milivojevic completed 26 of 34 passes for 247 yards with no interceptions in the Spartans' opener.
Cam Edwards, a transfer from Connecticut, ran for 98 yards and a touchdown in the Spartans' opener against Toledo.
